title: 2027 Kia Sportage Hybrid Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Kia Sportage Hybrid gets additional FWD models and a new Technology Package option to keep it competitive with rivals such as the Hyundai Tucson Hybrid and the Toyota RAV4.
body_markdown:
The Kia Sportage Hybrid is a compact SUV based on the popular, gas-only Sportage. Competitors include the Honda CR-V Hybrid, the Toyota RAV4, and the Hyundai Tucson Hybrid.

## What’s New for the 2027 Kia Sportage Hybrid


The Kia Sportage Hybrid moves into the 2027 model year with new front-wheel-drive (FWD) versions of its base S and EX trim levels. There’s also a new Technology Package for the X-Line trim, which features a Harman Kardon audio system, a driver’s memory seat, a surround-view camera system, blind-spot monitors, rear cross-traffic alert with braking, side parking sensors, and Kia’s Highway Drive Assist semi-autonomous system. These updates follow a more comprehensive refresh for the 2026 model year, which included updated exterior styling, a new dashboard and steering wheel, a slight bump in horsepower, and a couple of new trim levels.


## Design


The Sportage Hybrid is a compact SUV with a fresh, modern look, and the 2026 facelift brought it into line with the brand’s current upscale look and feel. Highlights include angular lighting, a textured grille, bold haunches, and sporty-looking alloy wheels. The base Sportage Hybrid gets 17-inch wheels, but 18- and 19-inch designs are available or standard with higher trim levels.


## Powertrain


The Sportage Hybrid features a 1.6-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine paired with two electric motors, good for a combined 232 horsepower and 271 pound-feet of torque. That hearty torque figure aids acceleration off the line, and a six-speed automatic transmission provides smooth shifts. The 2027 Sportage Hybrid is estimated at 40 mpg city, 42 mpg highway, and 41 mpg combined with FWD, and 35/36/35 mpg with AWD.


## Interior


The Sportage Hybrid has a bright, airy cabin with a modern design and smart details, such as an abundance of soft-touch surfaces. Like most vehicles in this class, there’s seating for five across two rows. There’s also enough front headroom and legroom for tall drivers, and a good range of seat adjustment. The second-row seats offer plenty of space and can also be reclined, but the panoramic sunroof slightly reduces headroom. Standard features include cloth upholstery and manually adjustable front seats, while options include power-adjustable front seats, heated front and rear seats, ventilated front seats, and synthetic leather upholstery. The Sportage Hybrid’s cargo area holds 39.5 cubic feet, which opens up to 73.7 cubic feet with the rear seats folded.


## Technology


The Kia Sportage Hybrid features a 12.3-inch digital instrument cluster and a 12.3-inch touchscreen integrated into a single display across the dashboard, giving the Sportage Hybrid a distinctly premium vibe. Standard features include wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Bluetooth, and a six-speaker audio system. Options include wireless charging, an eight-speaker Harman Kardon stereo, and a smartphone-based digital key.

## Safety


The Kia Sportage Hybrid comes loaded with safety technology, including a rear-view camera, forward collision warning, automatic emergency braking, pedestrian and cyclist detection, front and rear parking sensors, adaptive cruise control, lane-departure warning, and lane-keep assist. Options include a blind-spot camera that displays a live camera feed on the display when the turn signal is active, and a remote smart parking system that’s activated with the key fob. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration had not crash-tested the 2027 Sportage Hybrid, but it awarded the 2026 model a five-star overall safety rating. The Insurance Institute for Highway Safety has not crash-tested the 2027 or 2026 Sportage Hybrid.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Kia Sportage Hybrid is on sale now, and the base-spec Sportage Hybrid LX, available exclusively with front-wheel drive, started at $30,590 (excluding $1,495 destination fee) at the time of writing. The S trim costs $31,290 with front-wheel drive and $32,890 with all-wheel drive. The EX costs $32,290 with front-wheel drive and $33,890 with all-wheel drive. The X-Line and SX-Prestige both include all-wheel drive and start at $35,790 and $40,690, respectively.
